recent.text: LaMelo Ball was in very good spirits after the game, laughing and joking with teammates in the locker room. There is no immediate word on his ankle injury, but judging by the mood, he seems to have avoided a major one.
recent.author: Jon Krawczynski

recent.text: Wolves gut out a hard-fought win, survive losing Ball to an ankle injury. Jaden McDaniels was the best player on the floor.
recent.author: Jon Krawczynski

recent.text: LaMelo Ball grabbing left ankle and needs to be helped off the floor. He's in a LOT of pain.
